as_told.title: Lear's tape: 8 miles east of Groom Lake
as_told.place_text: 8 miles east of Groom Lake, Nevada

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at a secret Nevada site, says he took his friends John Lear and Gene Huff out to watch a test flight, because he "had the test flight schedule" and knew it would happen on a Wednesday night. Lear's own recording from that night begins, "today is March 22nd, 1989. We're standing just about uh 8 miles due east of Groom Lake, Nevada, the super government secret test site." The researcher Grant Cameron adds that the group drove out in Lear's motor home and filmed the craft, which, if it is what they say, would mean they watched a secret craft being flown.
